_note: How each region and province plays (src/provinceRules.ts, docs/ONLINE_PLAN.md 5.2). Each layer lists only what it changes: the game's defaults, then the region's, then the province's. Multipliers are 0.1-5 (1 = as the game is), months are 1-12, chancePerMonth is 0-1, drought.share (how much less a water works gives in a dry-season month, when no rain fills the ground) is 0-0.9. Edited by the owner; once the game is online the same data lives in the server's database and an admin page edits it.

north._note: Tourism: shops are wanted. Thick forest: clearing woods costs more.

northeast._note: Cheap land and farm industry. Droughts: a long dry season for the water works, fires in the hot season.

central._note: Trade: shops are wanted. Floods in the rainy season.

west._note: Hydropower: power plants give more. Little flat land: roads and rail cost more.

south._note: Tourism and seaports. Storms at the end of the year.

provinces._note: Changes for one province over its region, e.g. "TH-83": { "demand": { "commercial": 1.6 } } for Phuket. A province that lists seasons replaces its region's list.
